description: Pair-level directional mapping catalog bound to an exact versioned stimulus contrast. No pair contributes directional evidence unless mapping_status is VALIDATED and event asset identities match the mapping.

mapping_invariants.identity: pair_id, asset_a_id and asset_b_id must match the referenced stimulus_set_version exactly
mapping_invariants.VALIDATED: asset_a_direction and asset_b_direction must each be +1 or -1 and must be opposite
